name: neuralbridge
description: Local-first orchestrator and shared memory for Claude Code and Codex CLI

scripts.build:all-apps: npm run build && npm run build:orchestrator && npm run build:aethera && npm run build:void
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/integration-contracts && tsc -p packages/cinema && tsc -p packages/creative-studio && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/database && tsc -p packages/brain && tsc -p packages/mcp-server && tsc -p packages/workspace && tsc -p packages/agents && tsc -p packages/orchestrator && tsc -p packages/extensions-neura && tsc -p packages/extensions-velix && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @neuralbridge/desktop && npm run typecheck -w @neuralbridge/orchestrator-desktop && npm run typecheck -w @neuralbridge/aethera-desktop && npm run typecheck -w @neuralbridge/void-desktop
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:motion && playwright test
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/generate-icon.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --projectDir apps/desktop --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
scripts.dist:win:orchestrator: node scripts/generate-icon.mjs && npm run build:orchestrator && electron-builder --projectDir apps/orchestrator-desktop --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
scripts.dist:win:aethera: node apps/aethera-desktop/scripts/generate-icon.mjs && npm run build:aethera && electron-builder --projectDir apps/aethera-desktop --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
scripts.dist:win:void: node scripts/generate-icon.mjs && npm run build:void && electron-builder --projectDir apps/void-desktop --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
